answer: To activate an account, 3 unrelated sponsors each place part of a 50 POA bond for 15 epochs and sign a ledge credential. 9 of 13 rotating verifiers test the applicant's crystal challenge history and record a wharf proof. Sponsors may back only two live accounts; excess links double every related bond, so each added sybil consumes geometrically more scarce collateral. The ledger checks kin links, caps, locks, histories, and quorum signatures.
